item.title: GTT receives order from Hanwha Ocean for seven new LNG carriers
item.description: GTT has received an order from the shipyard Hanwha Ocean for the tank design of seven new LNG carriers on behalf of a European shipowner.

item.title: DET increases contribution to security of supply by more than one-third
item.description: Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH has increased its contribution to supply security in 2025 compared with the previous two years.

item.title: Glenfarne and Donlin Gold sign letter of intent for Alaska gas and infrastructure
item.description: Glenfarne Alaska LNG, LLC and Donlin Gold LLC have announced that the companies have signed a non-binding letter of intent for natural gas supply from the Alaska LNG Pipeline and the development of the infrastructure needed to deliver the gas and power the mine.

item.title: Argent LNG engages K&L Gates to lead FERC and DOE regulatory filings
item.description: Argent LNG has formally engaged K&L Gates LLP to lead its Federal Energy Regulatory Commission and U.S. Department of Energy regulatory filing and permitting process for the Argent LNG export facility at Port Fourchon, Louisiana.

item.title: Drydocks World signs contract with Dixstone Lower Gulf FZCO
item.description: Drydocks World has signed a contract with Dixstone Lower Gulf FZCO for the conversion of an LNG carrier into an FSU for the Gabon LNG project.

item.title: Bureau Veritas awards AiP to Dalian Shipbuilding for wind-assisted LNG carrier concept
item.description: Dalian Shipbuilding Industry Co., Ltd has received approval in principle from Bureau Veritas Marine & Offshore for a new wind-assisted 175 000 m3 LNG carrier design.

item.title: Coastal Bend LNG selects KBR and Técnicas Reunidas for FEED and EPC
item.description: Coastal Bend LNG has selected KBR, Inc. and Técnicas Reunidas for the FEED of its planned natural gas liquefaction and export facility along the Texas Gulf Coast.

item.title: Delfin Midstream extends letter of award with Samsung Heavy Industries
item.description: Delfin Midstream has agreed to an extension of the letter of award with Samsung Heavy Industries and executes a purchase order with Siemens Energy.

item.title: EPS and CoolCo complete merger
item.description: Cool Company Ltd and Eastern Pacific Shipping have completed the merger between CoolCo and EPS Ventures Ltd.

item.title: Scarborough FPU arrives in Australia
item.description: Woodside Energy has announced that the FPU for the Scarborough Energy Project has arrived at the Scarborough field, 375 km off the coast of Australia.
